# Contributors whose CLA acceptance is on record.
#
# One GitHub username per line, lowercase. Comments start with '#'.
# Checked by .github/workflows/cla.yml.
#
# HOW SOMEONE GETS ADDED
#
#   1. They sign off their commits (`git commit -s`) — the CLA names that as
#      the agreement, so a signed-off PR passes without an entry here.
#   2. Or they comment "I agree to the CLA" on their first PR, and a
#      maintainer adds them here in a follow-up commit.
#
# Bots are exempt in the workflow rather than listed here, so that a bot
# cannot be mistaken for a party that agreed to anything.
#
# Removing a name does not withdraw a past agreement — the CLA grant is
# irrevocable for contributions already made. This file records who has
# agreed, not who is currently active.

# Maintainer / copyright holder (Oolab Labs).
